reasons: The selector uses otel_metric_type="gauge", but nginx.requests is a monotonic sum in the dataset (dataset_types: sum), so the selector matches no series.
The rate() over a monotonic sum is the right quantity: cumulative requests become requests per second, matching nginx.net.request_per_s.

The Host template variable (prefix host, default *) should become a host=~"$Host" matcher, but the candidate omits it. Because the default is *, this does not change results, but the rule requires the matcher.
Outcome translated is correct, since an exact translation exists. The fix is to use otel_metric_type="sum" and add the host matcher.
